root_cause: Deploy 2.4.1 of checkout-api shipped without the PAYMENT_API_URL setting, so every request raises a KeyError.
evidence: deploy: version 2.4.1 deployed minutes before the errors began
metric:error_rate_percent jumps to ~100% right after the deploy
recommended_remediation: Roll back checkout-api to 2.3.0, then re-deploy 2.4.x with the PAYMENT_API_URL setting present.
risk_rationale: Rolling back a production deploy is a high-risk action.
title: bad deploy missing config (live)
